title: Finding → Verify Fix Bridge + Lit Fault Lab + Developer Guide
focusedCoverageAdded: installed panel bridge export smoke contract

strategicConclusion.wouldUse: Conditionally yes for difficult multi-signal frontend runtime incidents when it reaches a trustworthy source/action faster than native tooling; not for simple bugs.
strategicConclusion.need: Not universally. The product must prove value in the expensive gap between visible symptom and confident application change/replay.

limits: No statistical causal inference was added.
No automatic verification metric is invented for unsupported finding kinds.
The Lit fault lab is an acceptance/example harness, not proof that every production Lit app exposes every signal automatically.
